file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to open

offset.description: The line number reading starts from; pass it only when the whole file is too large for a single read

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to return; pass it only when the whole file is too large for a single read.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "2-6", "9", "12-24"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

line_anchors.description: Set true to stamp each text line prefix with its content anchor ("N#hhhh") — the copyable address for anchor-qualified Edit hunks. Off, the output is the plain numbered form.
